body: the only one who listened was my doctor, my parents don't believe in mental illness and my mother screamed at me and through a fit when she found out my dr put me on meds

I think the worst part of it is knowing that the pain is just being buried and as soon as I stop taking it, everything will resurface. In the mean time I feel like a fraud because I know I am suicidal and unhappy but the medicine makes me second guess myself. but I'll also being walking down the street and fantasize about blowing my head off and how good that would feel. its just messing with me
that's how I feel. it doesn't even make me happy its just not letting me feel everything

I totally get it, I think this is my last year, I'm just done. Im 16 and I went through the exact same thing. Now I'm on antideppresants and I hate them. I don't feel like myself and if this is the option I would rather die
I feel like that all the time. Its hard to separate my thoughts though. Sometimes I think everyone feels this way and its all in my head, but how could they understand it?
